text: At 640x360 the checklist fills top half of screen and the help text overlaps the aim name/hint/progress meter at centre; 'Pry it off...' hint is unreadable under help lines.

While carrying shingles the carry line 'Carrying Bundle of shingles: hold the left button where it goes' wraps onto a 2nd line that collides with the tool bar; meanwhile the aim still offers 'Braided rug - Take it (E)' even though hands are full.

Roof holes are nearly impossible to find at night: indoors with lantern lit, the hole is a black patch against dark ceiling; only the centre label reveals it. Also the hint still says 'Bring shingles from the wagon' while the player is already carrying them. tick ~27600

Carrying a New plank: the held plank is drawn across the centre of the view, covering the crosshair and the rotten-board gap you are trying to aim at; aim label reads only 'Floorboards' and it's unclear where to hold the button.

Standing by the window with a New plank, crosshair on the dark rotten-board gap (pitch -39.6): the centre shows no name at all and holding the left button for 5s does nothing; planksLeft stays 3. Aim reads 'Floorboards' a few degrees either side. Could not find any spot that accepts the plank.
